title: Ladybug holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- heart held by ladybug -->
  <path d='M50 52 C44 44, 30 44, 30 54 C30 62, 40 68, 50 76 C60 68, 70 62, 70 54 C70 44, 56 44, 50 52 Z' fill='#ff5a7a' stroke='#ffd0da' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- ladybug body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#e8322f' stroke='#ffb3a7' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- wing split -->
  <line x1='50' y1='45' x2='50' y2='79' stroke='#3a1512' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- spots -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='55' r='4' fill='#2a1216'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='55' r='4' fill='#2a1216'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='70' r='4' fill='#2a1216'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='70' r='4' fill='#2a1216'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='63' r='3' fill='#2a1216'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#5a2a2e' stroke='#a86a70' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d='M44 34 Q40 26 34 24' fill='none' stroke='#a86a70' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 34 Q60 26 66 24' fill='none' stroke='#a86a70' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='23' r='2.5' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='23' r='2.5' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='41' r='3' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='41' r='3' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='41' r='1.3' fill='#3a1512'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='41' r='1.3' fill='#3a1512'/>
  <!-- little smile -->
  <path d='M46 47 Q50 50 54 47' fill='none' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <path d='M34 58 Q28 56 24 60' fill='none' stroke='#5a2a2e' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M34 66 Q28 68 25 72' fill='none' stroke='#5a2a2e' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 58 Q72 56 76 60' fill='none' stroke='#5a2a2e' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 66 Q72 68 75 72' fill='none' stroke='#5a2a2e' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
